# Nexra Creative

> A creative content studio based in Dorset, serving Dorset, Hampshire and the
> wider UK. Content strategy, social media management, video and photo production,
> web design and SEO for brands that would rather be interesting than loud.
> Works with a handful of clients at a time. Operating since 2020; took the
> Nexra Creative name in 2026 after trading under a previous name.

Engagements run as fixed-scope projects, month-to-month retainers with 30 days
notice, or consulting where an in-house team needs direction. Everything is quoted
individually. Process: Enquiry → Conversation → Proposal → Agreement → Production
→ Publish & report. Contact: hello@nexracreative.com

## Services

- [Content Strategy & Creation](https://nexracreative.com/content-strategy-dorset.html): Audit, messaging, tone of voice, repeatable formats, editorial calendar, copywriting.
- [Social Media Management](https://nexracreative.com/social-media-management-dorset.html): Channel strategy, monthly planning, publishing, community management, reporting. Month to month.
- [Video & Photo Production](https://nexracreative.com/video-production-dorset.html): Brand films, product, team and location shoots. Edited in-house, raw files handed over.
- [Web Design & Build](https://nexracreative.com/web-design-dorset.html): Fast hand-built static sites, mobile-first, accessible, no lock-in.
- [SEO & Organic Growth](https://nexracreative.com/seo-dorset.html): Technical SEO, indexation, service and location pages, Google Business Profile, honest reporting.

## Areas

- [Bournemouth](https://nexracreative.com/creative-agency-bournemouth.html): Creative and content agency serving Bournemouth — tourism, professional services and the creative cluster. Seasonal content planning.
- [Poole](https://nexracreative.com/creative-agency-poole.html): Creative and content agency serving Poole — marine, manufacturing and trade businesses. B2B content for credibility and recruitment.
